before.body:
## Objective

Verify the installed Claude Code package through its documented lifecycle and Backplane conformance checks.

## Bounded Scope

### Allowed

- Complete and replay native guide commands for repeat install, pinned update, rollback to the recorded prior revision, and Backplane-only uninstall.
- Verify before/after identity and preservation for each operation, including unrelated plugins, user files, upstream Superpowers, repository history, and GitHub issue state.
- Run all five named Backplane conformance checks and authorized issue-state scenarios against disposable or explicitly authorized issues.

### Out of Scope

- Change the approved host contract or silently update/remove upstream.
- Run mutation scenarios on production issues without authorization.
- Claim rollback when the previous version cannot be restored and verified.

## Acceptance Criteria

- Repeat install remains one effective Backplane installation; a pinned update reaches the selected revision; rollback restores the recorded prior revision and required discovery; uninstall removes only Backplane-owned state.
- The exact guide commands pass in a disposable Claude Code profile. Failed candidate preflight leaves the prior verified installation available where restoration is supported, with a specific recovery action.
- Fresh sessions after applicable operations discover upstream using-superpowers and both Backplane skills from separate packages; all five conformance checks and authorized read-only, selection, design, readiness, execution, blocked/resume, review, and verified-completion scenarios are scored.

## Verification Seams

- Record Claude Code version, Backplane before/candidate/restored revisions, upstream source and revision, gh capability, three installed skill identities, and PASS/FAIL/UNKNOWN per operation and check.
- Run skill-structure, native-issue-intake, language-neutral-verification, lifecycle-transitions, and superpowers-installation with their mapped scenario rubrics.
- Prove zero issue mutation for read-only/selection; one correct Backplane label on each open tracked test issue; unrelated labels preserved; completed closure only after integrated evidence. Compare unrelated plugin, user-file, and upstream identity before and after every lifecycle operation.

## Superpowers Artifacts

Functional design: docs/superpowers/specs/2026-09-19-v0.1-adoption-installation-contract-design.md (approved 2026-09-19).
Rescope design: docs/superpowers/specs/2026-09-19-host-installation-leaf-rescoping-design.md.
Approved recovery plan: [Claude Code lifecycle and conformance recovery](https://github.com/tvproductions/superpowers-backplane/blob/6903e064302e5ad30843ebcd5aa5561f67a2f287/docs/superpowers-backplane/plans/2026-10-24-issue-19-claude-lifecycle-recovery.md). Operator approval and native inline execution with one fresh final reviewer were confirmed on 2026-10-25. This plan consumes issue revision `2026-09-27T14:09:57Z`; the current objective, scope, acceptance criteria and native graph are unchanged. The September27 draft and recovered October24 branch plan/evidence remain historical context. Publication of the plan is not lifecycle completion; #19 remains in design preparation until readiness prerequisites are verified.

parent.body:
## Objective

Publish a small, evidence-backed Backplane v0.1.0 that an adopting project can install and operate without repository-author assistance.

## Bounded Scope

### Allowed

- Native plugin adoption for Codex, Claude Code, OpenCode V1 and V2.
- Clear installation, lifecycle-mutation, licensing, operations, pilot, verification, and release work.
- Native GitHub sub-issues and blocking relationships for the release product arc.

### Out of Scope

- Support for agent harnesses outside Codex, Claude Code, and OpenCode in v0.1.0.
- Deterministic helper tooling unless field evidence makes it necessary for v0.1.0.
- GitHub Projects, IssueOps, or a standalone generic backlog framework.

## Acceptance Criteria

- Every release sub-issue is closed as completed with its own integration and verification evidence.
- Codex, Claude Code, OpenCode V1, and OpenCode V2 each pass their own fresh-host installation leaf verification before release.
- A fresh adopting-project pilot passes the Backplane compatibility and conformance contract.
- A licensed, documented v0.1.0 release is published from verified integrated source.

## Verification Seams

- Native sub-issue and blocking relationships show the complete release arc.
- Four supported host variants have native installation leaves with recorded test evidence before release.
- The integrated target passes the project-owned release verification recorded by the release leaf.
- GitHub exposes the resulting tag and release.

## Superpowers Artifacts

Background: `docs/superpowers/specs/2026-08-16-superpowers-backplane-bootstrap-design.md`.

V0.1 adoption design authority: `docs/superpowers/specs/2026-09-19-v0.1-adoption-installation-contract-design.md` (approved 2026-09-19).

This parent is a continuity node, not an executable leaf. Each executable child must link its own approved design authority and current Superpowers plan before becoming ready.

dependent.body:
## Objective

Accept the integrated native Claude Code installation surface against the approved v0.1 contract.

## Bounded Scope

### Allowed

- Review completed Claude package, setup, failure, lifecycle, conformance, and guide evidence from the bounded implementation work.
- Score the current installed-package matrix from integrated source and rerun a verification seam if its package, guide, host, upstream, or GitHub CLI input changed after the owning evidence was captured.
- Correct an integration defect needed to make the delivered Claude Code surface meet the approved contract.

### Out of Scope

- Implement Codex or OpenCode adapters.
- Copy Backplane skill text or vendor upstream Superpowers.
- Require a consuming-project runtime, GitHub Projects, or IssueOps.
- Treat closed prerequisites or a documentation assignment as proof of a passing live host run.

## Acceptance Criteria

- The Claude package, setup, and lifecycle prerequisites are each closed with reason completed and their integrated artifacts are reachable.
- Every mandatory row in the current Claude Code installation matrix is PASS; FAIL or UNKNOWN blocks acceptance. Each row records a current host version, Backplane revision, upstream source/version or revision, gh capability, and three separate installed skill identities.
- Clean installation, compatible native/sibling/absent-upstream setup, repeat installation, pinned update, rollback, Backplane-only uninstall, failed-preflight preservation, five named conformance checks, and authorized issue-state scenarios have evidence against the integrated candidate. Any changed input has its affected seam rerun.
- A fresh Claude Code session discovers upstream using-superpowers and both Backplane skills from independent installations. Unrelated plugin entries, user files, upstream Superpowers, repository history, and issue state remain intact through Backplane operations.

## Verification Seams

- Compare the approved contract and current ownership matrix row by row with the integrated package, guide, and evidence links. Require PASS on each mandatory supported-host check and precise source revisions; do not infer PASS from an issue state.
- Reproduce affected fresh-session or lifecycle checks when an input changed; record the exact guide commands and their observed result.
- Verify the five named checks and authorized status, selection, design, readiness, execution, blocked/resume, review, and verified-completion scenarios were scored on disposable or authorized issues. Require zero mutation for read-only paths, one Backplane label on open tracked issues, unrelated labels preserved, and completed closure only after integration.

## Superpowers Artifacts

Functional design: docs/superpowers/specs/2026-09-19-v0.1-adoption-installation-contract-design.md (approved 2026-09-19).
Rescope design: docs/superpowers/specs/2026-09-19-host-installation-leaf-rescoping-design.md.
Plan: not yet created.
